The 33-Word Paraphrase

Can you rewrite a complex financial news sentence while keeping exactly the same word count? Test your precision writing skills below.

article Source Sentence

33 WORDS

"The Securities and Exchange Commission yesterday said companies trading on the biggest U.S. markets must win shareholder approval before granting stock options and other stock-based compensation plans to corporate executives."

edit Your Paraphrase

0 / 33 WORDS

verified Expert Solution

EXACTLY 33 WORDS

"The U.S. market regulator, the SEC, stated yesterday that corporations listed on the largest American stock exchanges require investor backing prior to issuing equity options and related share-based payment schemes to top executives."

Key Vocabulary Swaps Used:

SEC ... said Regulator ... stated
win ... approval require ... backing
trading on ... markets listed on ... exchanges
granting stock options issuing equity options

Context June 30, 2003

The "Post-Enron" Reforms

The sentence refers to a pivotal moment in U.S. financial regulation. On June 30, 2003, the SEC approved groundbreaking rules for the NYSE and Nasdaq. These rules closed loopholes that previously allowed companies to issue stock options to executives without asking shareholders first.

"The final rules provide a meaningful response to shareholders' demand for enhanced corporate governance..."
